data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 新年参拜的许愿
data.description: 冬装大衣围巾，她在神社绘马上认真写下「今年也要画出更好的画」，挂上去时垫着脚努力够高处；呼出的白气与晨光里，她的表情是罕见的、毫无阴霾的笑。
data.action: 踮脚把画着心愿的绘马挂高，迎着晨光露出笑容。
data.promptProse: Sagiri Izumi writes a wish to draw better pictures on a wooden ema, then stretches onto her toes to hang it high on the shrine rack. Her cream winter coat, pink wool scarf and boots stay secure as she smiles freely, breath visible. The medium portrait includes other plaques and the wooden support behind. Morning light catches the scarf weave and new plaque's edge, with rack shadows across the cold ground below her reaching arm.
